verdict.rationale: Lever's first-party Career Site Builder pages describe a no-code, template-based careers site with point-and-click editing that anyone on the hiring team can build in minutes. They also cover branding with your company logo, colors and font, which addresses the branded, no-engineering parts of the story. The pack does not show that the site runs on the customer's own domain or that ATS job postings publish to it automatically, so those core parts are only implied. Missing for 10: custom/own-domain hosting evidence, explicit automatic job publishing from the ATS to the careers page, independent or hands-on corroboration.
